nodes.label: Paperclip Agents App
nodes.rationale: Paperclip as the agents application of org-os: zero-config recognition of federation.yaml, AGENTS.md, skills/, memory/, .well-known/org.json means any org-os instance gets a full agents dashboard (Fastify API on 3100, Vue 3 UI, PostgreSQL/SQLite) with just npm run setup — no CLI needed for non-technical users; multi-org support gives each instance an isolated Paperclip.
